text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, the Senior Year summer training 
camp came to an end. The decisive battles 
of autumn were drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, ain't nothin' to sweat about. 
Hubby trained me real good at this 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, ain't nothin' to sweat about. 
Big Sis trained me real good at this 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even if we end up facing Oguri and the 
others, there's no way in hell I'll lose!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...That's right, there's no way I'd lose.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—Alright, let's head back to the academy. 
Once we get back, we've still got plenty 
of training to do!”
